title.rendered: 141 – Give us this day our daily bread

content.rendered:
I am that bread of life. [49] Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead. [50] This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die. [51] I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

The Israelites had just sang the jubilation song after coming out of Egypt. They witnessed Pharaoh, their oppressor drowned in the sea and for the first time, many of them felt free. In just a couple days, they realized that they were in the wilderness and none of them knew exactly where they were headed, besides that it was a land flowing with milk and honey. It was in this state that God introduced the manna in Exodus 16, which was meant to sustain them through the wilderness. The rules were simple. Each was to go everyday and gather the exact amount of manna they needed each day, no more no less. Those who gathered more, had exactly what they needed and those who gathered little, had enough. Some thought they could hoard the manna, but only found worms the next day instead of left over manna. This was except on the 6th day where they collected double manna because no one could work on the 7th day.

We, like the children of Israel, after being delivered from the bondage of sin and death and we are beginning a journey we have not been on before. All we know is that when He appears we shall be like Him, what that means exactly and in details, we are still figuring out, 1 John 3:2. The Lord in preparing the disciples for that coming kingdom while they journey to this Kingdom asked them to pray “Your Kingdom come, Your will be done. Give us this day our daily bread”, Matthew 6:10-11. This daily bread is meant to be our sustenance while journeying to all that Christ is. Seeing that the promise we have is spiritual, the bread is also spiritual. What is this bread? Jesus in John 6:48 said that He is that bread of life and that who ever eats this bread, unlike the manna, would never die. This was a big claim, but also one that Jesus made unapologetically because it is truth.

The potency of this bread can be seen in the case of the Syrophoenician woman who had a demon possessed daughter in Mark 7:24-30. She begged for healing for her daughter and Jesus mentioned that He could not give the children’s bread (covenant children – Israel) to dogs (unbelievers in this case). She then requested for the crumbs. This crumbs resulted in her daughters healing. If the crumbs of this bread could heal a demon possessed person, imagine feasting on the bread. No wonder Jesus said, he that eats it will never die. This bread is His flesh that we are to eat. John 1:14 said the Word of God became flesh and dwelt among us. His flesh is His Word which is broken or made simple for us that we may partake of it and live forever. The command is also simple like the case of the manna. Jesus told us not to worry about tomorrow because it had its own troubles, Matthew 6:34. The bread of life for each day is sufficient for the days challenges and gives the measure of God necessary to deal with the challenge for that day.

To live forever means to live according to the law of the Spirit of life and above the law of sin and death, Romans 8:2. In essence, since sin brings death, living forever means living above sin. Eating this bread daily insulates us from the various attacks we face by day and by night, so cause us to sin and therefore stay separate from God, which is death. Every day, we are to approach the Lord and ask for bread. This bread is a measure of His person, not just in text of scripture. His Words are Spirit and life. They are Spirit that give life. The manner of the Lord is that He reveals Himself gradually to an individual and as they grow in capacity based on the revelation of yesterday, He gives more for today. This is the life of those in the wilderness, of them who have no continuing city, but seek the coming Kingdom. The essence of coming to God every day is that we learn to depend on Him and not act presumptuously. The days we are in are getting darker by the day and we need light and life every day to combat this darkness. Beloved, yesterdays bread was sufficient for yesterdays troubles. Yet, the Lord provides manna daily that you may keep growing in strength, your path shining brighter and brighter until the perfect day. 

Prayer for today: Lord thank you for daily giving Your flesh for me, that I may partake of Your life. Help me to be diligent each day to come to you to hear Your counsel and to partake of the life in Your Word. Lord give me this day my daily bread, a deeper revelation of Yourself that will help me stand amidst the arrows that fly in the day, the destruction that lays in wait at noon and the pestilence that walks in the darkness. Give me this bread that I may live in Your sight forever. Amen.

I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD And the praises of the LORD, According to all that the LORD has bestowed on us, And the great goodness toward the house of Israel, Which He has bestowed on them according to His mercies, According to the multitude of His lovingkindnesses. [8] For He said, “Surely they are My people, Children who will not lie.” So He became their Savior.

Isaiah 63:7-8 NKJV

One of the famous quotes of Jesus is that no one builds a house without counting the cost, Luke 14:28-30. God is a wise builder and investor and like any wise investor, He does an analysis on the potential of an investment before putting in His resources. The greatest display of God’s faith in man was when He gave all that He has to redeem man. An investor would typically be told to diversify his or her portfolio so as to mitigate risks. However, this was not the case with God. He threw all of His chips into one basket. Imagine what would have happened if Jesus came to the earth and yielded to the temptation of Satan to bow down to him to receive the Kingdoms of this world in Matthew 4:4 or if he reviled back when slapped and tempted. Romans 6:16 says whoever you yield yourself to becomes your master, this means, we would all be doomed because God would have essentially lost the Kingdom to the devil according to His own principles and law.

The level of investment put in you shows the level of interest and faith God has. In Isaiah 63:7-9 the prophet was overjoyed when realizing the plan of God. He looked at a sinful bunch of people, not those who were righteous, but blind in sin. He would have easily destroyed man and re-created another, but He saw a potential in them to not lie. What does it mean to not lie? Numbers 23:19 says, God is not a man that He should lie. This means, He saw a potential for this man to be like God. He was actually very hopeful and believed in this potential that He signed up to be their saviour. Isaiah 63:9 says that in all their affliction, God was afflicted and bore their sins and carried them and redeemed them in His love. Wow! Ephesians 1:16-19 shows us that God has an inheritance in the saints. This makes sense, considering the level of investment He took and is still taking to redeem man.

After analyzing this deal, Jesus sent the Word of His power to man. This Word of His power is the same Word used to create and uphold the World. It never fails, this is why His word is seen in Revelations 19:11-13 as one having many crowns from various conquests. His faith is in His Word that will not fail. This Word came to man as a saviour to ensure that He would not lie. Hence Jesus said in John 10:35 “Are they not gods to whom the Word of God comes?”. Now for this Word to be effective, it has to be believed in and received. An example of this is the conception of Jesus in Luke 1:26-38. Jesus is called the Word of God. Hence once Mary heard the Word from God and believed, this Word entered into her and became flesh in her and she conceived and bore a Son who is called the Word and the Son of God. This is the major risk God takes with man. In order for His Word to be effective in your life, it needs to be received. So He does a deal analysis, because His word must surely comes to pass. Jesus never casts precious pearls or treasure in His Word to swine or pigs. These may have ears but do understand or recognize the one speaking, Matthew 13:10-15. Yet, to His vessel of choice, if there is faith lacking , once they turn to hear Him, He increases their faith too. We see this example with Gideon in Judges 6. God called him a mighty man of valour and this man had the least bit of faith to believe that, but He at least heard with more than just His physical ear. Gideon recognized it was God speaking. After hearing, God Himself stirred up the faith in Gideon and He was indeed a mighty man of valour.

What is the summary of this meditation? Jesus believes in you. Jesus spoke in Matthew 13:44 of an investor who saw a treasure hidden in a field and He sold all He has to buy a field. While not all will receive Jesus now, the truth is that someday, everybody will fall on their knees and acknowledge Jesus as Lord, because the entire field, which speaks of the World, is His. Yet in this field, there are His Jewels. Jesus would not waste His investment. If you have heard the Word of God, know that it will surely come to pass. He is not a bad investor and cannot lie. Someday everyone will hear the voice of God, even the dead will live. That said, if you notice God sitting down to teach you the scripture, Showing hidden truths and breaking it down to you, this is Him giving You pearls. This means you are not a swine! Know assuredly that this investment cannot fail. It is not because You are strong to be able to accomplish all that God has said, but that His Word is strong enough to accomplish all that has been spoken towards you, Isaiah 40:26. Jesus has this confidence in His father, that when He had offered up His soul for the sins of many, He will see the reward of His soul and be satisfied, Isaiah 53:10-11. In view of this great profit, He endured the cross and the shame and has hope and faith that He will have His full reward in You. Beloved, it’s worth believing and confessing the same. “In me, Jesus will have His full reward”. 

Prayer for today: Father thank you for taking a chance on me. You could have wiped me out and all of man, yet, You saw us as a treasure and chose to buy the entire field for the sake of the Jewels. Lord in Me, all, both the field and the Jewels will bring You pleasure. I choose to believe Your Word. Make me into that which You saw at the beginning that gave You great Joy when hanging on the cross. I will be as You said, one like God who does not lie. Amen.

content.rendered:
A highway shall be there, and a road, And it shall be called the Highway of Holiness. The unclean shall not pass over it, But it shall be for others. Whoever walks the road, although a fool, Shall not go astray.

Isaiah 35:8 NKJV

In every generation, there have always been the group of people who moved differently than the masses, being led by the Holy Spirit. These are always in transit and do not settle, having no continuing city on the earth. They are always moving from one understanding of God’s truth to another. God calls them the wayfarers. Their journey is always a wilderness journey, because God will always have them depend on Him. They are led into the wilderness and they come out of it. To them, this wilderness is described as a place of gladness. Among these people, there are usually wonderers, normads and vagabonds with no sense of direction. These wonderers look like and speak like the wayfarers, but are not. The wayfarers are typically dissatisfied by what is seen among the masses and this drives them to seek God. God typically separates the two classes of people in the end by judgement. Wayfarers develop the fear of God after seeing the coming judgment and they flee and learn to walk the way of holiness. Our meditation today is on the way. Jesus said in John 14:6 “I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one comes to the Father but through Me“. He is the only way of truth that leads to life. The intent of this meditation is that each man evaluates his life and ensure that he is on the high way to life.

It is important to know that the way is not man’s idea. It is not politics or democracy. God leads, not man. In Exodus 13:17-18, Moses wrote that the Lord chose not to lead the people through the easy road or the path of the Philistines, but through the wilderness. God led them by the pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night. During the time of Moses, everyone could see the cloud. If Moses was sleeping and cloud begun to move, a little child could see it and would come and wake Moses up. This is because God is the one leading and not a man. These men also had the Urim and Thummim for direction. They are a prophetic people. They are in the wilderness and so they cannot afford to move without the direction of the Lord. In the wilderness, there is no doctor, so anyone who is sick would need to seek God for a solution. The wayfarers, coming through the wilderness learn to seek God for the littlest to the greatest of things. We are also in this wilderness and can learn to live this way. Seek the Lord in everything and wait for Him till He speaks. Rather than run to advil when sickk, seek for God’s counsel and hear what He says. He may lead you to a doctor, or He may direct you to change your diet or lifestyle. The way of the wilderness is a way of total dependence on God.

The wayfarers also sleep with no fear. Having seen the judgment of God upon sin, they have developed a deep fear of God. This fear also creates a deep love for God because they see a God who is an all consuming fire, but chooses to be among them. This understanding therefore, drives away every other kind of fear. These men do not fear death. An example of such men is Joshua and Caleb in Numbers 14. They said “If God delight in us, He will give them the land”. The gaints in the land, were in their eyes a bunch of glorified grasshoppers. The only concern they had was God delighting in them, Numbers 14:8. If you still have a fear of death, you cannot walk this way. The fear of death is the major fear of man. This fear drives him to all forms of ungodliness. However, Jesus came to deliver men from the fear of death, Hebrews 2:14-15. Death was a law that Christ abolished and He instituted the law of the Spirit of life in Christ, Romans 8:2. If you still fear death, you need to cry out to the Lord for His deliverance if not you cannot survive the wilderness or the way.

Finally, this way is where God trains the people for the Kingdom. We mentioned in previous meditations, that these wayfarers know where they are coming from and they have the end in mind. Learning to walk the way of Holiness, this way is designed to bury all that is of a vagabond nature. Those who submit to this discipline of God will have this nature removed from them and will come out successfully from the wilderness.However, those who will not will be buried in the wilderness. The rule of His House is Holiness. It is a way of holiness, righteousness, truth and peace. These who come out of the wilderness successful will be those through which He would smite the nations and bring His Kingdom to earth. 

Prayer for today: Lord today, I choose the way of the Lord. Though not a common way, it is a way of Wisdom and truth that leads to life eternal. Help me to submit to your will today that every nature of the vagabond will be removed from me. Here, I have no continuing city, but I seek Your coming Kingdom wherein dwells righteousness, peace and Joy.

title.rendered: 138 – Building strong Foundations for Stormy times – 2

content.rendered:
If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?”

Psalm 11:3 NASB

Matthew 7:25-27 shows that the type of foundation a man has would determine his state after the storm hits. Psalm 11:3, said if the foundation is destroyed, there is nothing the righteous can do. The three major reasons a physical foundation is examined from time to time are Age, a regular maintenance schedule and signs of visible damage. In today meditation, we will continue considering the four things to check while inspecting the foundation. These four things affect individuals and the local assembly. Yesterday, we understood the importance of maintaining good relationship with God on a daily basis and how to check ourselves daily by His word.

The next important foundational matter to check is to ensure that there is an understanding of the structure and proper functioning of the body of Christ. In 1 Corinthians 11:29 – 30, Paul said “For he who eats and drinks, eats and drinks judgment to himself if he does not discern the body. For this reason many among you are weak and sick, and a number sleep“. Discerning the body of Christ means understanding the princinples of the operation of the body of Christ. What are these principles?

  • Christ is the only head of the church and we all owe Him our allegiance. Ephesians 1:22-23. This verse shows that Christ is the head of the church which is His body. A man calling himself the head of a church or calling other believers his flock and Lording over them is very erroneous. Christ made it clear saying He is the head and we are all brethren, Matthew 23:8.
  • There is only One church, Ephesians 4:4-6. This error has made many in the body of Christ go into a serious error. Regardless of the congregation, there is only one true church without factions or denominations, Christ’s church.
  • There are several tribes in the house of the Lord. Psalm 122:3-4 says Jerusalem is built as a city, where the tribes of the Lord go up. The Emphasis here is “the tribes of the Lord”. 1 Corinthians 12 explained that the body is not made of the same parts. Each individual something unique they offer and this makes the body function normally, each joint supplying.
  • Physical attendance of church services does not translate to being in the register of God. Hebrews 12:22-23 indicates to us that God has his own register of true believers from different local assemblies. The bible calls them the church of the first born written in heaven.

Another foundational check is the need for the presence of God each time we gather to Him. The church of Jesus is not a political or social organization, but a living Spiritual body with life, a solution centre. The bible says the Kingdom is not in words, meat and drink but in demonstration of power, 1 Corinthians 4:20. Every local assembly must desire and experience the power of God every time they gather. Jesus said where two or more are gathered, there He is in our midst, Matthew 18:20. He also said He will build His church and the gates of hell will not prevail, Matthew 16:18. If a local assembly is experiencing powerlessness or is being prevailed over by the devil, there are typically two reasons: The assembly is condoning sin or there is no freedom of expression. A lack of freedom of expression can either be that one person or one group of people minister every time, while the others remain bench warmers and are not encouraged to bring out their gifts. That said, The church of God is not a place of democracy or having a “turn by turn” mentality, While there should be freedom of expression, nothing is to be done for vain glory or with strife in mind, Philippians 2:3–7. The leadership (plural) of a local assembly needs to find a balance between allowing people who evidently have graces to minister and encouraging and stirring up gifting in upcoming ministers. As someone rightly said, a true minister preaches his or herself out of the pulpit. This is because the result of the ministry raises others who will take up their place in an even greater capacity.

Finally, We need to possess a missionary Spirit. 1 Peter 3:15 says we must be ready at all times to give a reason for the hope that was in us. Your missionary field may be your office. It may be your neighbourhood. Every believer and local assembly must see his or herself as a missionary and must seek to know his or her primary missionary field. Also, every local assembly must encourage outreaches for it to stay alive. The bible says the gospel of the Kingdom must be preached in all the World and then the end will come, Matthew 24:14.

These are all ways to check and ensure we are still in the faith and remain steadfast and immovable, always abounding in the work of God. These will ensure we can weather any storm and remain standing, even through the fiercest of storms.

Prayer for today: Lord Jesus today, I pray for myself and my local assembly. Search through us to see if there is any place we may have missed your mark and are walking in our own understanding. We want to be a church walking clearly in the ordinance of God. Lord I also pray for the leadership of my local church that you give them the grace to lead your people in the way of the Lord. Not lording it over your flock like the unbelievers do, but ministering to the saint, till we all come in the unity of the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God, not moved by any wind or storm that is to come. Amen

title.rendered: 137 – Building strong Foundations for Stormy times

content.rendered:
“There will be signs in sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among nations, in perplexity at the roaring of the sea and the waves, [26] men fainting from fear and the expectation of the things which are coming upon the world; for the powers of the heavens will be shaken. [27] Then they will see THE SON OF MAN COMING IN A CLOUD with power and great glory. [28] But when these things begin to take place, straighten up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

Luke 21:25-28 NASB

For the past week we have been looking at the the importance of a foundation to the overall structure of a spiritual building, either an individual or a local assembly. In Revelations 3:7-13 Jesus spoke to the church in Philadelphia about a temptation that will try the whole world, regardless of each mans status and He promised to keep them.  This was a church functioning on a higher realm than all the other churches, they had brotherly love. It is clear that the Lord wants us to expect the difficult times and prepare for it. One of the signs of the end is world wide commotion. These commotions will have expressions in various ways in the earth. The world is still passing through health issues now with Covid 19. We are also having global security issue where nations are buying ammunitions to destroy one another. We have economic issue as well with economic decline. We have environmental disasters as well, with the issue of climate change. In Luke 21:26, Jesus said that mens heart will fail them for the many things coming on the earth. Daniel 9:25, however, says that the way shall be built in troublous times, so we know that the storms are intentional. While all these commotions are making men afraid, the men of the Kingdom should not be afraid because Jesus warned us already. Jeremiah 12:5 says that if we are weary while contending with footmen, what will we do when the horsemen come?

Matthew 7:25-27 shows that the type of foundation a man has would determine his state after the storm hits. In Psalm 11:3, we are told that if the foundation is destroyed, there is nothing the righteous can do. There are three major reasons a physical foundation is examined from time to time. A primary reason is because of age. Spiritually, the more you grow in the Lord, the more your foundation needs to be revisited. One of the reason why many servants of the Lord who have known the Lord for many years fall is because they take things for granted. Another reason the foundation is examined is because of a regular maintenance schedule. No serious engineer or organization will build a a tall building and have no maintenance schedule. They must check regularly to ensure everything is in place, especially the foundation.The third reason is when signs of failure are seen in the structure, like cracks. There are times where a honest believer see failures in their lives. By the time a serious believer begins to do certain things that are a shock to him and those around him, he needs to revisit the foundations. This also applies to local assemblies. One of such faults in a congregation is false teachings or unbiblical doctrines. Another is when sin and carnality is becoming common. This shows that there is a problem with the foundation the church rests on. We do not need to wait for a disaster before we examine our foundations. Rather, we examine our foundations to prevent a disaster.

In today and tomorrows meditation, we will consider four things to check while inspecting the foundation. These four things affect individuals and the local assembly. Today’s mediation will focus on the first point, which is maintaining a daily communication with God. Relationship with God as individuals or as a local church is a foundational matter. The reason is because coming to Christ is one thing, remaining in Christ is another thing. If we start a race and do not continue or finish the race, we are losers. Peter says those who turn back are like dogs returning to their vomit, 2 Peter 2:22. Why would a believer start well, but finish poorly. Why would churches gather together and after a scatter? We see this all around and this is a sign of a faulty foundation. The scripture admonishes believers to check themselves every day, 2 Corinthians 13:5. Each congregation also needs to perform regular checks. Doing this involves:

  • A daily study of the Word of God. Psalm 19:7 says the law of the lord is perfect converting the soul. One of the things that God uses to bring us back to shape. When approaching God, come with praise and pray in other tongues, before approaching the Word, then your heavens will be open and you can hear God clearly via the Word.
  • A life of prevailing daily prayers daily. Ephesians 6:18 says we should pray all manner of prayers in the Spirit. Prayer is communication with God. No husband will like if their spouse is home but would not talk to them. Prevailing prayers involve  prayers that are made with every attention and passion in you and concentration. James 5:16-17 says that our prayers must be effective and fervent. Praying in other tongues is very effective and of course with a regular life of fasting.
  • The Spirit of repentance. This means being very ready to repent whenever God shows us that we are wrong. The bible says whoever covers his sin will not prosper.
  • Living like a child of God and not as the gentiles (unbelievers). Consecration to God is not a choice but a must for anyone who will weather the storms coming.
  • Serving God with everything He has given you is a sign of a devotion to God. Everything we have comes from God and we must serve and worship Him with it. This means that your money, house, etc is for the glory and use of God.
  • Being ready to preach the gospel at all times.

Doing these will ensure your foundations run deep and can weather any storm.

Prayer for today: Lord Jesus thank You for sending Your Word to me today. Help me not to be slothful, but diligent in ensuring that I touch base with You every day for my daily bread. Your Word said in the parable of the tares that while men slept, the enemy sowed unwanted plants. Help me to stay awake and watch. Lord keep me from the storm and trial that will try all the World. Hide me in the secret place until the indignation be over past. Amen

excerpt.rendered: There are consequences of having a strong foundations and not having one. Jesus told us that stormy times would come, with men’s hearts failing them because of the disasters coming on the earth. Daniel 9:25 also says that the (true) way shall be built in troublous times. A strong foundation to weather these storms can therefore not be over emphasized. Every individual and local assembly should expect the rain, the flood and the wind and prepare for it

title.rendered: 136- Jehovah said to Adonai (An exposition on Psalm 110) -3

content.rendered:
The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool. [2] The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies. [3] Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

Psalm 110:1-3

In Psalm 110:1-7, David in the Spirit prophesied of the Work and victories of the Christ, the Son of God. By one sacrifice, He perfected forever those who will be sanctified, Hebrews 10:14. Christ was made a high priest after His glorification. The overall result of Jesus’ priestly ministry and his redeeming power towards man is that His people shall be all living creatures in the day of His power. Yesterday, we mentioned this harvest as the theme of the season. The latter rain is sent to these body of people, who would be the rod of His strength to harvest many souls to the Kingdom. This harvest, however, is not without opposition as Psalm 110:5-7 suggests. However, the verse also shows God’s response to the harvest. David in Psalm 110:5 says that in the days of His power, the Ancient of days will come and sit down and pass His final judgment.

How does Jesus handle this opposition? Psalm 110:5 says the Lord will strike through kings in the day of His wrath. He shall judge among the heathen. He will fill the places with dead bodies. Why will he do this? Because these dead bodies were those who had caused much death. The coming harvest is of two kinds: the harvest of the true and the false Vine. We are introduced to the true vine, which is Christ in John 15 and Numbers 6:3-4 shows the false vine. The harvest of the true vine is God, by His Spirit, raising up men and women who will be in His image and after His likeness. It is God raising up a people passionate for His glory, in the day of His power. This is Captured in Psalm 110:2-4. The second harvest, or the harvest of the false vine is shown in Psalm 110:5-7. This harvest is also seen in revelation 14:17-20. This is the harvest of the wicked, to crush the pride of man.

Revelation 15 shows the result of the harvest of the true vine. These men rejoice and sing songs of deliverance after overcoming the beast, his image, his mark and the number of his name, which we explained in an earlier meditation. These human angels (messengers) now move in the fulness of strength to execute the judgment upon the false vine. In preparation for this great harvest, God pours out His latter rain. Zechariah 10:1 asks us to cry out for the rain which will prepare us for the latter rain. This rain comes to strengthen feeble knees, to refresh the weary and to confirm God’s inheritance in preparation for the latter rain that will bring maturity, Psalm 68:9. We must cry out and allow ourselves to be prepared for a great harvest. Even now, the harvest has begun and the adversary is so scared of it. However, God, by judgement will bring the nations to their knees and some in each nation will come to the feet of Jesus in worship. Psalm 110: 7 shows that as a result of the day of the Power, Jesus will be satisfied as one whose thirst has been quenched. We all shall know the unusual move of the Holy Spirit in our lives. The greatest days under the law and the greatest days under the prophets shall break forth upon us. The greatest day under the law were the day Moses and the greatest day under the prophet were in the days of Elijah and Revelation 5,6 and 11 show that the church will express the great glory that shall come upon us in the day of the power of the Lord, in the likeness and power of Moses and Elijah.

In summary, prophecy has described us as a willing people who will give glory to God. We need to seek God in our congregations and individual altars for the least qualities that are to be found in the living creatures in Revelation 4. There is no time for distractions. There is no time for walking disorderly. We must be all out in seeking the face of our Lord for the upcoming outpouring of the Spirit and the out pouring of the Spirit now. As we do so, He will give rain. He will beautify us with the Beauty of Holiness. The latter rain will come to those who have received the Word, His rain, and submitted to it. We do not pray for the latter rain, we pray for preparation rain for the latter rain as Zechariah 12:1 says. The Lord is not catalyzing or exciting us by revealing what is on His mind. He is given us two main trusts: ‘Write the vision, and make it plain for the people I have chosen for Myself’. The next is that these people shall be willing in the day of the Lord’s power hence Habakkuk 2:2 says that those who read it will run. Isaiah 8:1 urges that we write it in the pen of a man, that is, in plainness of speech. Beloved, now is the time to seek the Lord until He comes and rains righteousness on you. Prepare yourself for the glory that is to be revealed in you.

Prayer for today: Lord I have heard Your Word and read the vision. Let me not hear these with my ears and read with my eyes alone, but let my heart grasp it that I may run. I want to be among these rod company of people that you will send out, who are passionate for Your glory alone. Lord I pray for rain. The rain of Your Word and of Your Spirit to refresh me and establish me as Your inheritance, to make me as one of Your living creatures with the boldness of a lion, the tenacity of an eagle, the strength of an ox to labour and pray and the heart of a man in compassion and love. Let me have eyes all around full of light and understanding of eternal things. So that when the latter rain comes, I may be among the willing ones in the day of Your power.

title.rendered: 135- Jehovah said to Adonai (An exposition on Psalm 110) -2

content.rendered:
The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool. [2] The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies. [3] Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

PSALM 110:1-3 KJV

In Psalm 110, David heard a conversation between Jehovah and Jesus where Jehovah essentially promised to finish the work Christ had started by making all His enemies worshippers at His footstool. It was a promise that since He had given His soul as an offering for sin, He will see the reward of His soul and be satisfied, Isaiah 53:10-12. In Psalm 110:2, David essentially prophesied the Word of the Father saying “Your Father will send a company of people out of Zion. A people from all tribes on the earth, but shaped into one, Zion. All of them will seek Your own glory alone. As living creatures in Revelation 4:8, they will say, Holy Holy Holy is He who sits on the throne. They shall be willing, abundantly willing and fully desirous to enter into the glory of the latter rain, the Day of Your power”. This latter rain is prophetically called the day of the power of Him that sits on the throne. It is the day of overwhelming encounter with the Person and Power of the Holy Spirit without measure. This is the major thing in the heart of God right now. All who receive an overwhelming of the Spirit of God shall not fail in one bit.

This latter rain is a mandatory rain that will surely some. It is the coming of the Lord, as sure as the morning, Hosea 6:1-3. In the first out pouring, some people came forth, some were faithful and some were not. These who receive this rain will all be faithful, submissive and work in the power of the Holy Spirit. The beast shall not prevail against them like the a certain people that failed in the past. The marks of the beauty and holiness and character will be seen in these people who will be willing and the beast shall remain in the bottomless pit in relation to them. The latter rain will not produce failures. This is why the rains come to instruct us on how to beautify ourselves and conduct ourselves. These people shall be born from the womb of God, announcing a new era, a new day. In Psalm 110:1-3, David is reporting what the Father said to the Son, How a people will go forth in the strength, dominion that has been written in Genesis 1:26-28 and wherever they go they will show forth His glory. This is what will be true of us once the latter rain is poured out.

In Psalm 110 2:4, David prophesied to Jesus the role He would play in all this as a High priest. Christ was made a high priest after His glorification. It is shown that He will function in the power of the High Priest after the order of Melchizedek, an endless life. When He comes as a high priest, He will complete the testimony of these individuals in Psalm 110:2-3. He will be an officiator of the new covenant shown in Hebrews 10:14,16-17: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified. [16] This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them; [17] And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more. As a High Priest of glorious things to come, He is able to save to the uttermost all who come to Him. The anointing of Jesus as the high priest makes us priests under the body of the high priest. The overall result of Jesus priestly ministry and his redeeming power towards man is that His people shall be all living creatures in the day of His power.

In Psalm 110:5, since the plan and counsel of God cannot fail, David also spots the intending opposition to the Lord’s plan and how this will be addressed. His words to the Lord gives us assurance in these times we are in, 2020 and beyond, where it looks like the world has changed to disfavour the church. Nothing will interfere with God’s plan. The name of the theme of these times is harvest. This because the sons of God are coming to full age. What this means is that the most glorious period of the church age is here. However, there is conspiracy to stop the church from harvest. Tomorrow’s meditation will consider the harvest, the opposition and God’s response in more detail. However, the thrust of this chapter is that upon the visitation of God in the latter rain, He will empower a body of people through which He will be glorified. In preparation for this, Zechariah 10:1 tells us to pray for rain, not necessarily the latter rain. The latter rain must come. However, it will only be of benefit to those who have been prepared by the earlier rains. This early rain is a teaching rain. It is the daily coming of the Lord to us in the medium of His word and guidance by His Spirit, to bring refreshing and to uproot of any tree that has not been planted by the Father. All who yield to this rain will have the same testimony of Jesus in John 14:30, “the prince of this world cometh and finds nothing in me”. These will not fail in the day of the Lords power. 

Prayer for the day. Father, it is written that Your people shall be willing in the day of Your power. In the beauty of holiness and from the womb of the morning. Father, be my strength, be my guide. Prepare me for this great outpouring. Send your rain to me today to refresh and teach me how to deny ungodliness, that when the Latter rain comes, all it will see in me to magnify is all that You are and nothing else. Amen

title.rendered: 134- Jehovah said to Adonai (An exposition on psalm 110) -1

content.rendered:
The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool. [2] The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies. [3] Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

Psalm 110:1-3 KJV

Psalm 110 is very interesting for various reasons. It is a conversation between Eternal ones. There are a couple observations to be made in our exposition of this chapter. The first thing is to note is that psalm 110 is a prophecy and prophecy is secondary. The voice of God is primary. God speaks and man prophesies, Amos 3:8. The second observation is that David was transported in the Spirit to hear a conversation between the eternal Spirit and Jehovah Adonai. Moses who came some 3500 years after the recorded human creation was privileged to hear these a conversation between these two persons that happened before he was born. Moses heard clearly in the Spirit where the Lord said “let us make man in our image” Genesis 1:26. Similarly, David was transported in the spirit to see what took place after the resurrection of Jesus Christ. It was 700 years before the event happened that He was given this prophecy. This means David heard a conversation that had not taken place then, but would take place hundreds of years afterwards. In the conversation, the Eternal spirit was speaking to the Lord our saviour, our redeemer, our Master. He beheld the glory of these two persons and he took what he heard and put it into a song.

Jehovah said to Jesus, sit at My right until I make complete the business of making Your enemies Your footstool. While many translations, including the King James version translates this as “Right hand”, there was only one throne. God did not ask Jesus to sit on an alternative throne on the right hand, but sit at “my right” on a place of Power and glory as seen in Revelation 5. He that is our foundation is also the one who sits on the throne. So complete was the work that was done in laying Him as the foundation that He sits on the throne. Another thing to note is that, the Lord is sitting in glory, expecting that His enemies be made His footstool. There are two classes of enemies. The first class are enemies of God after the fall, but conquered to make such a one a worshipper at the footstool. This was the case of you and I. However, He that sits on the throne went forth conquering and to conquer. He conquered us.  The total conquest of your soul and the crown of His victory over you life is on His head. He is wearing many crowns knowing that He has conquered millions of people via redemption. Such enemies would be made worshippers. The other class of the enemies are the incorrigible, who will be cut off and destroyed.

Romans 5:8-10 says “But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us. [9] Much more then, having now been justified by His blood, we shall be saved from wrath through Him. [10] For if when we were enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we shall be saved by His life”. Paul in Acts 9:1-31 was an enemy of God, but Christ overwhelmed Him and turned Him to be a worshipper at His footstool. He was breathing out threats against the church and God made Him, his footstool worshipper in His presence. Like we’ve seen, we will worship at His footstool as Psalm, 99:5 says. This is essentially saying “we will give You rest when You stand”. The Lord will stand upon the earth because of the feet company of the body of Christ. We will be the body of people through whom God will stand upon the earth in this last hour. Making enemies His footstool was not just speaking of the initial salvation alone, but the complete and total capturing of these individuals, bringing everything in their lives in obedience to Christ.

David, after seeing and hearing the plan of Jehovah in Psalm 110:1 turned to Adonai, Jesus, and began to prophesy to Him by the Spirit. He was speaking for the Father, therefore, Psalm 110: 2 David called God “MY LORD”. He said “The Father will send a company of people out of Zion. These company of people are from all tribes on the earth yet of one tribe. They have come to mount Zion and Your Father is working on them. He will send them out of His presence. This Zion is not the physical Zion near Tel aviv. It is Zion that  is spoken of in Hebrews 12. They are called from many tribes and are shaped to a single tribe. When this rod company of people, taken out from all the world begin to go out, then what was communicated in verse 1 will become the Your reality. These people will continue going forth in Your strength. Because of the work that shall be wrought in them, the conquest of their soul, they will be beautified and will go forth in Your strength. These ones have a passion for your glory, My Lord Jesus. They will go in the power of the Spirit of God that they have received and wherever they go, they shall conquer for You. Because they have a passion for Your glory, all of them will be willing and become favourable to you”. This was what David was saying to Jesus. Beloved, This was what was prophesied about you, thousands of years before you were conceived and in you, this prophecy will be fulfilled. 

Prayer for today: Heavenly Father, before I was even born, You knew me. Before I was conceived in my mothers womb, You had ordained that I will be made in Your image and after Your likeness, one who will bring rest to Your feet. Therefore I worship You today and forever. Thank you for giving Your life to me and making a way for Me to know You. I am confident in Your ability to complete whatever You start, therefore I rejoice today, because I know I am a person created and formed to reveal Your glory. I yield myself to you, Make me into all You have spoken of Me in the beginning. Amen

title.rendered: 133 – God’s reaction to detours in His eternal purpose in Christ (2)

content.rendered:
And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. [27] So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

Genesis 1:26-27 KJV

God’s intention for creating man in the beginning was to make a man in His image, after His own likeness. However, there was a detour with the fall of man. God who cannot lie made a promise to man from the beginning, giving him a hope of eternal life, Titus 1:1-3. For this reason God is the one who starts a work of recovery and it is to recover man to the vision, to Christ and God’s program in raising up Divine persons who bear the image of God and His likeness. He laid the foundation, which is Christ and all that is built must be according to the pattern which is Christ, 1 Corinthians 3:11-15. This house is a many membered body. When Jesus came upon the earth, He said in Hebrews 10:5, “A body thou hast prepared for me”. This body is the collective building of Christ to which He commits the whole of His wisdom, knowledge and power that they may express the fullness of His image and likeness in a body of people. No matter how much God works with a man, His purpose is beyond this man to a body of people. Man in all his capacity, is limited in his ability to receive the fulness of the revelation of God. This revelation of God can only be received in a body.

What is God’s reaction to the detour from His plan? Why is it called a divine reaction? Something is Divine when it sourced from God and when it expresses the will of God. God will always initiate the recovery of His plan from derailment but it will involve man; that is, giving instruction to a man who has ears to hear and understand Him. In Matthew 24:14-15, when there was a detour in His temple, with an abomination found in it, He gave a Word. to all who would listen. This word word contained clear instructions on what they would see and what they should do. Usually when there is a detour, there is a great deviation from the knowledge of God and from the knowledge of His will. Therefore, this work of recovery which is gradual is in a new environment, not in the environment where there is a rebellion or a detour from God’s way. Revelations 18:1-4 re-echos a similar call as in Matthew 24:14-15, for His people to come out from an institution which has turned away.

We see this pattern of recovery in Revelations 2 and 3. Here Jesus was moving through His church to judge all detours from His path. There was a call to repentance for all who hear and a promise to all who overcome. While His goal is a body of people who will walk in His image and after His likeness, He works with each man individually. If a church has strayed away from the true path, the individuals there cannot overcome in that environment. For this reason He gave Word and also judges these institutions. He also provides an environment where those who have an ear will grow spiritually and be nourished. Finally, He pours out His spirit to empower these ones who have heeded the call to repentance. The challenges of the present times, show that the enemy is putting forth a terrible fight on the earth. Satan has never been this destructive and mad as He is because He knows His time is short, Revelation 12:12. In such an environment where the pure Word of God is heard and adhered to, the church will experience God’s release of His divine power and grace. We are also in the season of the greatest outpouring of God’s glory and grace, because it is the hour of the harvest of all of God’s labour over the 6000 years of human history. It is the hour of the collapse of the Kingdoms of this world. It is also the hour of the speedy growth of the faithful.

We have a destination in the Spirit, that God is leading us unto. It is the fulfilment of the vision of what God has spoken to us in Genesis 1:26-28. In the midst of the confusion of the times, our eyes should not be taken away from the fact that there will be an outpouring of the Holy Spirit to complete our transformation and our resemblance to Christ in His image. In Genesis 1:28, man was to have dominion over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the cattle and everything that lives on the earth. All these beasts are grouped into two categories in revelations 13: the beast of the sea, which are the fishes of the sea and the beast of the earth, the other three categories. These four things are also symbolized in the song of the overcomers in Revelations 15, who had victory over the beast of the sea, his image, his mark and the number of his name. Isaiah 57:20 calls the sea the wicked of unregenerate humanity and the earth are those who were to be redeemed from the sea, but refused to follow the Spirit and remained earthy or carnally minded. However, in Revelations 15, the messengers, coming out of the sanctuary of the tabernacle of his testimony are clothed in linen, pure and shining, and girded round the breasts with golden girdles. This is an honour given to no spirit angel, these messengers are men. Christ in Revelation 1:11-17 is clothed in the same apparel and reserves this honour to His saints who overcome, Revelations 19:8. This is the finished picture before us. Beloved, have this vision ever before you. God who has promised to create you in His image and after His likeness is able and faithful.

Prayer for today: Lord, How precious are Your thoughts unto me. How great is the sum of them, such glorious things that have not entered into the minds of men. I know Your plan and Your promise for me and I know that You are able to give me an expected end. Great and Marvellous are Your works, Lord God almighty, Just and true are Your ways King of saints. I have heard Your Word and I rejoice today, because You are willing and more than able to make me in Your image and after Your likeness.

title.rendered: 132- God’s reaction to detours in His eternal purpose in Christ (1)

content.rendered:
Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.” [27] So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.

Genesis 1:26-27 NKJV

Before God made man, He had a completed picture in mind.He therefore set out to make man based on this picture. God revealed this vision in snippets through out the bible, which is summarized in Genesis 1:26-27. Who is the vision? The vision is a person, the Lord Jesus Christ. God has in mind to produce divine persons. These persons will have the same possession of the full image of Christ. Image is for character, so this persons must have characters that are exactly like Jesus. Also Jesus is the full likeness of the Lord God. We cannot be in His full likeness. However, God made it so that so that each of us will have different expressions of the likeness of God. However, all will have the same beauty of Christ. This is intent of God is seen in 1 Corinthians 15:23-24. Romans 8:26 says all creation await the manifestation of the Sons of God. This means all creation will see Jesus in these divine persons that God is raising. Creation shall see their God in His people.

If the vision is Christ and what God is doing is to raise us into the divine realm of persons with Christ’s Character and How does He do this? No one can produce Christ outside of Christ. So the vision is worked out by Christ. Christ is the one who works out Christ in us as seen in Hebrews 2:5-16. He does this by giving us the whole of Himself to redeem, man. He gave us His Word and also His power by the indwelling Holy Spirit of God. Christ is the worker and also the result of the work. He is the instrumental one needed to raise up many like Him. Philippians 2:13 shows that it is God who works in us to do His will. Another question we may ask is, who are the beneficiaries of this vision God has in mind? God set out to multiply Himself in man all through the earth and He is the main beneficiary of the work, because we are His inheritance as Ephesians 1:18-19 says. Man, however, is the secondary beneficiary. In Genesis 1:26, God created man. Genesis 1:27-28 shows that God involved man, although He begun the process of creating in the verse above.  He wants the secondary beneficiary, which is man, to grow and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it. Christ is the builder. Christ is the building, the mansion and the house.

The church is involved in the construction work also, but we must understand that we build together with Him and we are built by Him. Whoever will build with Him must be yielded to Him, so that He can take over the person and can work in the person. God showed us Christ that we man see His intention for creating man. However, our duty is to yield in obedience that He may create this same picture in us. Trying to be like Christ without His help is like building on sand, which Matthew 7:24-27 shows will be destroyed. Only the work done by Christ will last forever. Our responsibility is to yield to Him so that He might work His work through us.

Though God has been set to create in Man, Christ, He has been met with detours since the time of Adam. The major challenge is when there is a disconnect from the vision, whether it is in a man’s life or the life of the church. A concrete loss of the vision or when there is a willful ignorance of God’s word creates a major detour from God’s purpose. This always starts with a loss of moral excellence and then a loss of vital fellowship with God and then blindness to Spiritual realities and truths. This is the common progression with a man who has veered off the true path in Christ. However, because the Work is the Lord’s idea from the beginning, He always makes moves to reclaim His creation. God begins to awaken some, quicken them, instruct them and as they respond, he leads them out of the congregation that has made a detour from the path of life. He sends again His Word to them. In tomorrows meditation, we will explore in more details, God’s response to detours in His vision. Yet, it is important to note that God’s intent for you when you were created is that You will be Christ. That is your finished picture. Beloved, as His word comes to it, hold on to is and run with it. In it contains the power to transform your mortal tent (body) to one clothed with Glory and light. 

Prayer for today: Father of glory, I pray today that you may give to me the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of You, that the eyes of my understanding may be enlightened; that I may know what is the hope of Your calling, what are the riches of the glory of Your inheritance in me, Your saint, and what is the exceeding greatness of Your power toward me who believes, according to the working of Your mighty power displayed in the resurrection and glorification of Jesus. Amen

Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: [25] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock. [26] And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: [27] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

Matthew 7:24-27 kjv

Strong foundations are a defining factor for all who will remain standing in the faith in the time to come. Yesterday, we mentioned that there are foundations for remaining firm in the common christian faith, which Jude 1:3 calls our common Salvation. This basic call involves our faith in Christ, our life in Christ and our witness for Christ. We concluded that if our faith in Christ was not established on the solid foundation of truth, we cannot live right with Christ and that since our witness is first shown by our lives, we cannot effectively witness for Christ either. While there is the common salvation that most Christians concern themselves with, making it to heaven and remaining rapture-able, Philippians 3:14-15 shows that there is a higher calling for in Christ Jesus. There are so many things that we need to know and express about the life of God in this life. Some of which can be seen in promises to the overcomers in Revelations 2 and 3. An exposition of these promises can be found here. However, this is for those who have an ear to hear the emphasis of God now. When we give ourselves to what the Lord is doing on the earth and what He is saying now, we are giving ourselves to the high calling by the spirit of prophecy. The testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of prophecy as seen in Revelations 19:10. God is expecting that there are those that will soar above the storms coming on the earth.

A major aspect of what the Lord is doing at this time of the end is found in Isaiah 2:2-3.  

Isaiah 2:2-3 NKJV
Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the LORD’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And all nations shall flow to it. [3] Many people shall come and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths.” For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

God is going to let the world know that the His presence in His house is superior to anything else in the world. An example of this was shown by Moses when He faced Pharaoh in Exodus 7:8-13. Aaron cast his rod on the ground that turned to a serpent. Jannes and Jambres, the two magicians of Pharaoh did the same, but the rod of Moses swallowed theirs. There are many powers that will express themselves in these last days, showing up signs and wonders. However, just as God used Moses and did not need to physically come down to Egypt to deal with it, He will use a people through who He will break all resistance to His rule and establish His Kingdom on earth. These are prophetic people who have and follow the Spirit of prophecy and as a result, are able to live in a higher standard of life and authority than all around them, including many believers. Not everyone that are Christians will fit into this picture, God’s instruments in fulfilling the vision of Isaiah 2. God is going to bring out a church from the general church. These people are called the Rod of His strength as seen in Psalm 110:4. They are those who willingly offer themselves in the day of His power, after understanding and hearing the demand upon them by Spirit of prophecy.

To follow the Spirit of prophecy closely requires a higher life in the Spirit. In Revelations 4:1-2, John was told by the Lord “Come up hither (here)” and when he listened and obeyed, a door was open to Him in heaven. What does it mean to come up hither? Improve on the quality of your life and relationship with God. It is both a separation from the world and to the purpose of God. There are many things going on in the world that are a distraction to what God is doing now, but from where God is sitting, by answering the higher call, we can see things perfectly. God, in these times, is calling a people out of the world, including the institutionalized religious denominations that have become worldy, defiled and polluted. Another example of heeding to this high calling was Moses’ call to the mountain in Exodus 24. God called him to come up to the mountain and be there. The amount of time he needed to be there for was not given, but Moses obeyed. During this 40 days, He saw the glory of God and got the law. It was probably during this time as well that He saw the plan of God from the beginning and wrote Genesis. Yet in all this, there was Aaron who was meant to be the high priest and a spiritual leadership in Israel. Staying on the ground, he was swayed by a lot of the demands of the mixed multitude that he built a golden calf to lead the people away from God to idols, Genesis 32.

Moses had to call those on the Lord’s side out of the general assembly of Israel, just like God is calling His people out now from the polluted and defiled set up that many call the institutionalized church today.The expectation is that a people will step up in the spirit having stepped out of the corrupt set up. Christendom today is largely polluted by the love for money and sorcery. Many miracles today are done with the power of the dragon (the beast from the sea), the devil as seen in Revelations 13:12-14 and many are being deceived. Yet, the true saints of God will judge and destroy this set up, Revelations 18. There is a prophetic cry to all who desire to be a part of what God is doing now. Those who will ascend the mountain and be there. These will get the law of God to teach and instruct the people, turning the hearts of the children back to the Father again. Daniel 9:25 says that the true way of God will be established again in troublous times, yet they that know their God will be strong. There is a church coming out of the generality of the church and they are being trained to fulfil the purpose of God. While the work of God is going on among these remnants, there shall be commotion on the world, of which the corona virus is a taste. These people have been pulled out from many tribes but are of one tribe, Zion. They numbered in heaven as seen in Hebrews 12:22-24. As Psalm 87 says, when the Lord takes a roll call of all those in Mt. Zion, may your name be found in her! 

Prayer for today: Lord Jesus, You said Your people shall be willing in the day of Your power. Lord I know this is the day of Your power. I choose to heed to your call to come up to the realm where you are today and far from the distractions on the earth. Lord separate me to Your purpose and may the things of this world become strangely dim. May I not be like lot's wife who was saved from Sodom, but had her heart in Sodom and was destroyed with Sodom. Give me ears that always hear you and obey. Lord in these days of so much commotion where the days are evil, let my foundation be solid in You that I may be strong in the days ahead

Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: [25] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock. [26] And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: [27] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

Matthew 7:24-27 KJV

In yesterday’s meditation, we saw the importance of a solid foundation to the stability of physical building. Much more, a solid foundation is essential for the present time as well as the time to come. The world has entered into a season of night and morning. The night is symbolic of a time when there are problems and trouble and the morning is symbolic of when there is light, Joy and solutions. From the beginning of 2020, the World entered into the night season with the corona virus, but we are assured of the Lord that a morning shall surely come. Luke 21:26 says mens heart will fail them because of the things that will come upon the earth. We will see many foundations shake and crumble, but we are also going to see many foundations stand and be solid. In Matthew 7:24-27, Jesus spoke about two houses that are built upon two types foundations. One house was built upon the rock and the other was built upon the sand. We were told that the rain came, the flood came and the wind blew, three different elements. These three elemental forces beat against the two houses. Jesus told us that one house stood and one collapsed. The house that stood, stood because the foundation was on a rock.

In Revelation 3:10, Jesus sent a message to the church in Philadelphia. He said “Because you have kept the word of my patience, I will keep you from the trial that will try the world”. He didn’t say only the church will be tried but everyone. Yet Jesus promised them that He will keep them. What was the secret to this promise? The Philadelphian church was standing on the solid foundation. Paul knew the importance of a foundation built on God’s word alone. Hence He did not preach his experiences but Christ and Him crucified alone, 1 Corinthians 2:1-2. Anything built on the experience of man or outside of what Christ has done will not stand the kind of storms that are about to hit the earth. While considering the topic of the christian foundation, we will consider the foundation needed for the basic Christian calling and that of the high calling of God. Today, the emphasis is on the common Christian calling. It seems basic, but a crack in this foundation is often the reason for the fall of many who profess to be believers. There are three aspects to our basic and common Christian calling: Our faith in Christ, Our life in Christ and Our witness for Christ.

Our faith in Christ is based on our relationship with Christ. John 3:3 shows that just as we were born into our earthly family, but we must be born again into the heavenly family, which is the Kingdom of God. This happens when a person encounters Christ at salvation. As basic as this is to christianity, many fail here, speaking high sounding things, but never having a true personal encounter with God.  Our faith in Christ must be expressed before our life in Christ can be expressed. What we believe affects what we do. If our belief system is wrong and on a wrong foundation, we cannot live right with Christ. Unfortunately in Christendom, we often expect the life of Christ from people who never encountered God, even though they had spent their entire life in church. If a person is struggling to live a life worthy of the call of a Christian, it is important to pause and check the foundation, their belief system. This is especially important because Revelation 12:13-17 said that the dragon, the ancient serpent has been cast to the earth and has great rage because his time is little. Genesis 3:14 says the serpent eats dust. This is not a physical serpent, but the same dragon cast down. Anyone living with Character defects or carnality will be a casualty in the days coming.

In Ephesians 4:17, Paul was addressing the church that people should no longer live as gentiles. The major difference between a Jew and a Gentile is that Jews have a covenant or a relationship with God. Hence living like gentile meant living like an unbeliever. Only those who are having a strong and morally sound character will partake of the coming Kingdom. Any one with a faulty character and moral life will be food for the serpent. Our lives are part of our witness for Christ. This means we cannot have a good witness for Christ if our lifestyle is devoid of moral excellence and we cannot have a life with moral excellence if our faith in God is shaky. This meditation is a call to pause and examine our belief systems. Our faith, lifestyle and witness are all a matter of the heart. A man who has not encountered Christ, regardless of how many scriptures he can quote has a heart that is desperately wicked, Jeremiah 17:9. Yet God has promised to give a new heart and put a new spirit within all who come to Him, Ezekiel 36:25-27. Beloved, now is the time to examine your heart and your faith in the Lord. We will consider the foundations for the high calling of Christ tomorrow. However, If you are not walking in the basics of the christian call, a higher calling is out of reach. If there are areas of your faith that are shaky, cry out to the Lord and He will reveal Himself to you. God never ignores a cry for mercy!

Prayer for today: Lord Jesus, You know me in and out. You know my sitting and my rising. My heart is not hidden from You, nor my innermost thoughts. Lord search my heart and show me areas where my foundation may be shaky. Show me lies that I have believed that make me act the way I do. Purify my heart with the fire of Your holiness and establish my feet (my walk with you) on a solid foundation of truth, so that I can stand the trails that will come to all humanity. Hide me in Your holiness o God.

Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock: [25] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock. [26] And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand: [27] And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

Matthew 7:24-27 KJV

A brother saw a crack in the wall of his home and he called a painter to cover the crack. The painter came and patched up the wall. A month later, the crack came back. He called the painter to come back and redo the job. After the painter had finished the work, forty-five days later, several cracks showed up in the wall.This brother was frustrated at the incompetence of the previous painter and called for a professional and more experienced painter to fix up the cracks on his wall. This painter came in with his tools and observed the wall. He then went to the brother who hired him and said “Sir I cannot help you”. The man was annoyed and confused and asked if he also did not know how to fix a crack on the wall. The painter explained that patching the walls will not fix the issue because there were underlying problems with the foundation. This foundation had to be strengthened.

Some houses in hurricane prone countries are built to resist storms and earthquakes. These houses are often very difficult to build. One of the major differences between these and other houses is that the foundations go deeper than a regular house and the buildings are tied down to the foundation with tie-down straps, J-bolts, hurricane clips and other materials. The houses are also built to be impact resistant and to remain dry in a storm with sealants, waterproof materials and other mold and mildew-resistant materials . In Matthew 5,6 and 7, Jesus taught one of the greatest sermons ever preached. This sermon was the foundation for his ministry. After this, in Matthew 8, we began to see His miracles. After a long sermon, Jesus concluded this sermon differentiating between two individuals, the wise builder and the foolish builder.

What differentiated these two? Before exploring the differences, it is important to highlight the similarities. Both men were builders and had a dream to build a house that will last. The word house here can also be family, society, ministry, etc. The verses preceding this parable were about Jesus speaking about people who did mighty things in His name but were rejected, being called workers of iniquity. No man intends to build a house, family, society or ministry that will fail. Another thing to note was that they were both christians. Both sat under the greatest teacher of all time, Jesus and heard the greatest message of all times, the sermon on the mount for several days with Christ. Matthew 25:1-10 also shows the story of a wise and a foolish group. Both were virgins, untouched and reserved for the Lord, but a group was rejected for being foolish. The last thing to note is that both faced the same issue, the storms of life. Storms are designed to test the foundation, so God allows them. So what separated them? Wisdom is defined as the application of the knowledge of God’s word. Foolishness is defined as the inability or refusal to apply Spiritual truth to life’s challenges. The storm will come to everyone. Where we are fastened to is what makes the difference.

A requirement for the strong foundation for this present time is the same as the requirement for the time passed. God does not change.In Exodus 24:12, the LORD said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them. We often neglect the call to “be there”. Moses did not know how long he would be there for or when God will speak to him. It was said that when he went up, a cloud covered him and God spoke to him through the cloud, but he was there for forty days and forty nights. We cannot build a solid house without knowing the blue print and cannot know the blue print for any thing that will last forever, without being in the presence of the eternal one. Beloved, the Lord is saying to you today “Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast“. (Isaiah 26:21). When Peter caught the revelation of who Jesus was in Matthew 16:13-19, Christ told him that upon this rock, not Peter, but the revelation of truth, He will build His church and the gates of hell will not prevail. If you look around today at societies, families, ministries and churches that are being prevailed on by the gates of hell, check the foundation!

Prayer for today: Lord Jesus, as You have commanded me in Deuteronomy 13: 4 to follow after the You and fear You, and keep Your commandments and obey Your voice; To serve You and to hold fast and cling to You, I choose to yield Lord. Help me to base my life, home, ministry on Your word, by sitting at Your feet and observing to do all that you tell me. Then, my life, ministry, family and society will stand the test of time. Lord as You established the earth and it abides, establish me on the Solid Rock and I will abide forever. Amen.
